title: Gates consume verdict content: a critic block record blocks a passed critic node's gate

notes: GREEN: the record exists AND the gate consult consumes it — gate blocked while the node itself is passed (locks 5fcff602/983ce35a structurally). RED: the same record exists but the legacy gate ignores verdict content and passes on completion alone. gate_replay mode: the driver exercises the REAL scheduler/dispatcher/ledger seams inside the sandbox HARNESS_DIR. GREEN env sets SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=1 (the Lane 3 fix); RED injects SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=0 (the pre-contract world) and the same expect must fail — proving the scenario discriminates the class, not the plumbing.
